blurb.text: A Rhône Valley appellation at the southeastern edge of the region, in Provence, with 36 communes in the Vaucluse. Known as Côtes du Luberon until 2009, it is made from Grenache, Syrah and Mourvèdre for red, and Clairette, Grenache Blanc, Marsanne, Roussanne and Vermentino for white.
